brand.name: Eain
brand.tagline: Digital gifts that feel like home.
brand.splashTagline: A little gift, made with love.

hero.title: Digital gifts that feel like home.
hero.subtitle: Make something special. Give it to someone.
hero.note: The person you send it to never needs an account.

connections.title: Made for every kind of connection
connections.subtitle: Not only for couples. A home can be a friend, a family, a classroom or a team.
connections.friendsText: For the one who is always there.
connections.distanceText: Close the gap with a small surprise.

showcase.title: Start from a template
showcase.subtitle: Ten looks for birthdays, thanks, memories and more. Every word and colour is yours to change.

trust.title: Private by default. Shared by choice.
trust.privateText: A gift is visible only to people who have its link. You can turn it off or change the link any time.
trust.receiverText: No account, no app, no tracking of where they are or what device they use.
trust.yoursText: We never sell your data or use your gifts for advertising or AI training.
trust.learnMore: Read how we protect your gifts

legal.draftNotice: This is a draft written by the Eain team in plain language. It will be reviewed by a lawyer before public launch, and it is not legal advice.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Questions, requests to delete your data, or something that does not look right. We read everything.
contact.emailText: For account questions, data deletion requests and anything else.
contact.emailSoon: A contact address will be published here before public launch. Until then, use the report link on any gift page for content issues.
contact.reportText: Every gift page has a "Report this gift" link at the bottom. Reports go straight to our moderators and do not need an account.
contact.securityText: Please tell us privately before sharing it publicly. We will acknowledge and fix it.

howItWorks.chooseText: Pick a template that fits the moment.

howItWorks.replyText: Their answer comes back to you.
